entities.description: A person is sitting cross-legged on a gray fabric couch, wearing a lavender satin pajama set with white piping. The couch has a modern design with clean lines and a textured upholstery, and a beige throw pillow is placed on the right side.

clothing.bottoms: lavender satin pajama pants with white piping

entities.description: A young woman with dark curly hair and round wire-rimmed glasses sits cross-legged on a grey sofa, wearing a lavender satin pajama set with white piping. She has a neutral expression and is looking directly at the camera with her hands resting on her legs.

clothing.details: white piping on collar, cuffs, and pockets

entities.description: A square, beige throw pillow with a textured, woven fabric surface rests against a dark gray background. The pillow features a subtle grid-like pattern and appears soft and slightly plump, with visible creases and folds indicating a relaxed state.

A large window covered by white horizontal blinds is visible in the background, providing a bright, diffused light source behind the subject. The blinds are closed, creating a uniform pattern of horizontal lines across the entire background area.
